place.source_title: Gregor S. and Elizabeth B. Affleck House, 925 Bloomfieldwoods Court

brief: Frank Lloyd Wright's first Detroit-area house (1941), a one-storey Usonian: long low walls of red brick and horizontal wood, flat roofs with broad overhangs, a flat-roofed open carport at the entrance, a tall brick chimney mass, raised brick planters and ribbon windows, set into a wooded slope on a curving suburban court.

facade.notes: Frank Lloyd Wright's Affleck House (1941), a Usonian house: long low brick masses, flat roofs cantilevered far out as a carport over the drive, a tall brick chimney block, clerestory and ribbon glass; set into a wooded ravine below the road; a mushroom-shaped lamp at the carport

why.note: Wright's Usonian houses: flat roofs, carports, brick and wood, the house hugging its site
Wright invented the term 'carport': the car under a cantilever, not in a box
